comments.text:
DRIFT AUDIT COMPLETE — AGENTS.md + README + 6 skills vs bw v0.13.0 (audited 2026-05-29).

=== HIGH PRIORITY ===
[1] skills/beadwork-install/SKILL.md is materially STALE and now partly WRONG.
- Premise throughout: "latest release is v0.12.3 (2026-04-12); the worktree fix (PR #117) is only on main; build from source." 
- Reality: v0.13.0 shipped 2026-05-12 and CONTAINS PR #117 (dc1c4be "Ignore worktreeConfig extension when opening repos (#117)" appears in the v0.13.0 changelog).
- Consequence: Path A (install.sh) is now the correct default. The entire Path B (Go toolchain, clone main, ldflags version injection, mandatory smoke test) is obsolete scaffolding. The 0.12.4 version-threshold compare is moot. The banner's own stated removal condition ("revise once v0.12.4+ is no longer relevant") is now TRUE. Author/verified date stamps (2026-05-08) are stale.

=== MEDIUM ===
[2] bw recap (#122, new in v0.13.0): "summarize activity across issues," --all cross-repo fan-out, --json. Directly relevant to beadwork-for-meta-analysis Beat 2 (currently cites only bw show / bw list). -> bws-vk0.2.
[3] Cross-repo id resolution + prefix aliases (#123) + host-local registry / bw registry list|prune (#125) strengthen the cross-team/cross-org story in beadwork-as-bus Beat 3 and tiers 2-3 of AGENTS.md. -> bws-vk0.3.

=== LOW ===
[4] Storage-modes/pricing tables (AGENTS.md, README, overview, install) re-verified ACCURATE (GitHub pricing, four modes) — no change needed, EXCEPT AGENTS.md ~line 226 ("go build from source for pre-release fixes") should soften now the fix is released. -> bws-vk0.4.
[5] bw attach / ticket attachments (#119) not covered anywhere; could strengthen audit-trail use cases (attach evidence to a decision ticket). -> new low-pri child.

=== NO DRIFT (confirmed current) ===
- beadwork-as-memory, -as-bus, -for-meta-analysis, -for-decisions reference only stable commands (bw show / history / list / create / comment / close) — all valid in v0.13.0. Persona/pitch prose is evergreen.
- AGENTS.md core pitch, three-tier model, six-skill list; README: current.

Edit tickets spawned as children of bws-vk0. Closing this audit ticket.
